# Target release

**Target**: UCO 1.6.0

This is a backward-compatible, optional-property addition to `types:Hash`.
It does not invent a new Hash subclass, does not add proprietary algorithm
names to `HashNameVocab`, and does not alter existing graphs. CASE and UCO
1.5.0 are released, so this additive change targets the next 1.x minor.

# Background

Investigators already record both cryptographic and similarity hashes as
`types:Hash` on `ContentDataFacet`. Method and value exist today
(`hashMethod`, `hashValue`). What is missing at the UCO layer is a
**public version string** so two hashes with the same method name can be
compared only when they were produced by the same published version of
that method.

What we achieve, for whom, and why it matters: forensic examiners and
tool authors can record a published perceptual-hash implementation version
on the Hash node itself, so later reviewers can query comparable hashes
without stuffing a version token into `hashMethod` or inventing a local
property.

The Crimes Against Children Ontology already has domain subclasses of
`types:Hash` (`cacontology-detection:PerceptualHash` and a more specific
licensed-algorithm subclass). Those terms should remain CAC-domain
specializations. UCO should stay generic: method, value, public version,
and ordinary action/tool provenance.

Until this lands, the SDK interim pattern remains `types:Hash` plus an
`InvestigativeAction` / `Tool` pair. This proposal does **not** change
vendored OWL in the SDK.

# Requirements

## Requirement 1: Optional `types:hashVersion` on `types:Hash`

Add an optional datatype property:

- IRI: `https://ontology.unifiedcyberontology.org/uco/types/hashVersion`
- Domain: `types:Hash`
- Range: `xsd:string`
- Cardinality: 0..1

The value is the **public** version identifier published by the tool or
library that computed the hash (for example `0.9.6`). It is not an
algorithm specification and not a catalog schema.

## Requirement 2: Provenance stays on Action / Tool

Do not add a parallel provenance property on `types:Hash`. Which tool
computed the hash, against which input, is already modeled by
`uco-tool:Tool` and `case-investigation:InvestigativeAction` (`instrument`,
`object`, `result`). The action's `object` and `result` remain the hashed
`ObservableObject`; `types:Hash` stays an inherent characterization and
is not used as an `action:result` (that pairing is disjoint from
`UcoObject` and becomes an error in UCO 2.0.0). This proposal only adds
the version string that those actions cannot attach to the hash node
itself.

## Requirement 3: Keep `HashNameVocab` open; do not add proprietary names

`hashMethod` remains an open vocabulary. This proposal does not add
product-internal or licensed algorithm names to `HashNameVocab`. Domain
ontologies may continue to subclass `types:Hash` where they need tighter
local constraints.

## Requirement 4: Reconcile with existing CAC terms

CAC `PerceptualHash` already subclasses `types:Hash` and carries
`hashAlgorithm` / `perceptualHashValue`. After Requirement 1:

- UCO `hashMethod` / `hashValue` / `hashVersion` are the generic carriers
- CAC properties remain valid domain specializations and should be
  documented as aligning with, not replacing, the UCO triple
- CAC match-result classes stay in CAC; UCO does not grow a match-score
  class in this change

# Risk / Benefit analysis

## Benefits

- Two hashes with the same method name become comparable only when their
  public versions match.
- Domain ontologies keep their specializations; UCO does not absorb
  licensed catalog concepts.
- Existing `types:Hash` graphs remain valid (`hashVersion` is optional).

## Risks

- Implementations that already stuffed a version into `hashMethod`
  (for example `PHASH-0.9.6`) will need a one-time mapping note. The
  submitter is unaware of other risks.

# Competencies demonstrated

## Competency 1

An examiner records a published perceptual hash (`pHash`, version
`0.9.6`) and a SHA-256 integrity hash on the same raster file. A later
reviewer must list only the perceptual hashes that share that public
version. Ground-truth positive: `kb:hash-phash-1` (`PHASH` / `0.9.6`).
Ground-truth negative: `kb:hash-sha256-1` (different method, no
`hashVersion`).

### Competency Question 1.1

Which `types:Hash` nodes on `kb:file-1` have `hashMethod` `PHASH` and
`hashVersion` `0.9.6`?

#### Result 1.1

`kb:hash-phash-1` only.

### Competency Question 1.2

Which tool, via an investigative action whose `result` is `kb:file-1`,
produced `kb:hash-phash-1`?

#### Result 1.2

`kb:tool-1` (`name` = `open-source pHash library`), through
`kb:action-1`.

### Draft SPARQL

```sparql
PREFIX uco-core: <https://ontology.unifiedcyberontology.org/uco/core/>
PREFIX uco-observable: <https://ontology.unifiedcyberontology.org/uco/observable/>
PREFIX types: <https://ontology.unifiedcyberontology.org/uco/types/>

SELECT ?hash
WHERE {
    <http://example.org/kb/file-1> uco-core:hasFacet ?facet .
    ?facet uco-observable:hash ?hash .
    ?hash a types:Hash ;
          types:hashMethod "PHASH" ;
          types:hashVersion "0.9.6" .
}
```

(The action/tool join for CQ 1.2 is in
`change_proposals/generic-perceptual-hash-characterization.sparql`.)

The example graph is also available as a standalone file at

empty file and a placeholder perceptual digest. It does not contain case
data.

```json

  },
  "@graph": [
    {
      "@id": "kb:file-1",
      "@type": "uco-observable:ObservableObject",
      "uco-core:hasFacet": [
        {
          "@id": "kb:file-1-file-facet",
          "@type": "uco-observable:FileFacet",
          "uco-observable:fileName": "empty.bin"
        },
        {
          "@id": "kb:file-1-content-facet",
          "@type": "uco-observable:ContentDataFacet",

      }
    },
    {
      "@id": "kb:hash-phash-1",
      "@type": "types:Hash",
      "types:hashMethod": "PHASH",
      "types:hashVersion": "0.9.6",
      "types:hashValue": {
        "@type": "xsd:hexBinary",
        "@value": "0123456789abcdef"
      }
    },
    {
      "@id": "kb:tool-1",
```

# Related proposals and references

- [`add-blake3-to-hashnamevocab.md`](add-blake3-to-hashnamevocab.md) — related
  `types:Hash` / `HashNameVocab` work. That proposal adds one cryptographic
  algorithm name. This proposal does **not** add algorithm names; it only
  adds optional `hashVersion`.
- CAC `cacontology-detection:PerceptualHash` — existing domain
  specialization of `types:Hash`. Remains in CAC; UCO stays generic.
- [pHash](https://www.phash.org/) — source of the public version-string
  example (`0.9.6`) used in the competency graph.
- No open UCO issue was found that already proposes `hashVersion` or a
  generic perceptual-hash characterization on `types:Hash`.

# Solution suggestion

* Add optional datatype property `types:hashVersion` (`xsd:string`,
  cardinality 0..1) to `types:Hash`.
* Add a SHACL property shape `types:Hash-hashVersion-shape` (`sh:datatype
  xsd:string`, `sh:maxCount 1`) targeted at `types:Hash`. Do not close the
  class.
* Do not add algorithm names to `vocabulary:HashNameVocab`.
* Do not add provenance properties on `types:Hash`; keep tool and input on
  `Tool` / `InvestigativeAction`.
* Do not edit SDK-vendored `ontology/UCO` from this repository. A prototype
  T-Box used only for pre-submission validation is at
  `change_proposals/generic-perceptual-hash-characterization.ttl`, with
  shapes at
  `change_proposals/generic-perceptual-hash-characterization-shapes.ttl`.
* Add competency SPARQL (already in
  `change_proposals/generic-perceptual-hash-characterization.sparql`).
